text:
# 阶段一：测试目标系统、质量案例输入与可机器比较 Baseline v5.1

> 版本：5.1.0  
> 目标：提供稳定、可复刻、可重置、可比较的被测系统和人工成功案例。

## 1. 最终产物

```text
完整银行演示系统
Customer Portal
Mifos X Staff Portal
Operations Console
Quality Case Portal
Fixture Service
Baseline Registry
Business Assertion Service
Evidence Store
```

## 2. 工程结构

```text
apps/
├─ customer-portal/
├─ operations-console/
└─ quality-case-portal/
services/
├─ bank-channel-service/
├─ mock-clearing-service/
├─ fixture-service/
├─ baseline-service/
└─ assertion-service/
contracts/
├─ regression-case.schema.json
├─ baseline.schema.json
├─ formatted-case.schema.json
└─ evidence.schema.json
```

## 3. RegressionCase

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0",
  "caseId": "REG-PAY-001",
  "caseName": "正常本行转账",
  "businessGoal": "客户甲向客户乙转账100元成功",
  "entryUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:18082/transfers/new",
  "actorProfile": "customer.alice",
  "sourceTypes": ["NATURAL_LANGUAGE", "FORMATTED", "VIDEO"],
  "steps": [
    {"sequence": 1, "description": "选择客户乙为收款人"},
    {"sequence": 2, "description": "输入100元"},
    {"sequence": 3, "description": "确认转账"}
  ],
  "fixtureProfile": "PAYMENT_STANDARD",
  "baselineRef": "BASE-PAY-001"
}
```

## 4. BaselineDefinition

强制检查：

```text
关键可见文本
URL/Route
关键输出字段
Network Method/Path/Status
业务资源状态
错误状态
```

可选检查：

```text
截图相似度
布局
视觉状态
```

```json
{
  "baselineId": "BASE-PAY-001",
  "required": {
    "visibleTexts": ["转账成功"],
    "urlPattern": "/transfers/*",
    "outputs": ["paymentId"],
    "network": [{"method":"POST","pathPattern":"/api/v1/transfers","status":201}],
    "businessState": "SETTLED"
  },
  "visual": {"enabled": false, "threshold": 0.9}
}
```

## 5. Quality Case Portal

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段一_测试目标系统质量案例输入与Baseline_v5.1.md
text:
```text
/cases
/cases/{caseId}
/cases/{caseId}/natural-language
/cases/{caseId}/formatted
/cases/{caseId}/video
/cases/{caseId}/baseline
/cases/{caseId}/evidence
/cases/{caseId}/export
```

必须支持：

```text
上传视频
保存格式化步骤
保存自然语言描述
保存入口 URL、角色和数据
保存人工成功证据
导出统一案例包
```

## 6. 页面测试契约

```text
data-page-id
data-page-state
data-testid
role
aria-label
label
稳定路由
明确 loading/error/success
```

该契约用于生成稳定 Locator；Midscene 复刻仍以视觉模型定位为主。

## 7. Fixture 与认证

```text
POST /internal/test-support/v1/fixtures:seed
POST /internal/test-support/v1/fixtures:reset
POST /internal/test-support/v1/auth-state:create
GET  /internal/test-support/v1/fixtures/{logicalRef}
```

规则：

```text
逻辑引用，不暴露运行时 DB ID
每个 Replication/Validation/Regression 使用独立 Namespace
Storage State 本地短期保存
执行结束立即清理
```

## 8. Assertion API

```text
GET /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/{caseId}/{runId}
GET /internal/test-support/v1/payments/{paymentId}
GET /internal/test-support/v1/ledger/{correlationId}
GET /internal/test-support/v1/reconciliation/{correlationId}
```

## 9. 视频规范

```text
固定分辨率、DPI、语言、时区
完整显示操作
成功终态停留至少 2 秒
禁止真实 PII、密码、Token
记录应用版本和录制时间
```

## 10. 数据库

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_case (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  case_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  case_json JSONB NOT NULL,
  case_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE baseline_definition (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES regression_case(id),
  version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  baseline_json JSONB NOT NULL,
  sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## 11. 审计

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段一_测试目标系统质量案例输入与Baseline_v5.1.md
text:
```text
CASE_CREATED
CASE_EXPORTED
VIDEO_UPLOADED
BASELINE_CREATED
BASELINE_APPROVED
FIXTURE_SEEDED
FIXTURE_RESET
EVIDENCE_ACCESSED
```

## 12. 测试与验收

```text
[ ] 至少 30 条人工成功案例
[ ] 三种输入格式可导出
[ ] Fixture 可重置
[ ] Baseline 可机器比较
[ ] 页面状态稳定
[ ] 关键网络和业务状态可查询
[ ] 证据全部有 Hash
[ ] 无真实敏感数据
```

## 13. Definition of Done

阶段一完成后，任一案例都可以被阶段三读取，并能在独立环境中重复人工成功流程、获取明确 Baseline 和业务断言。
